title: Indian Market News Brief — 31 Oct 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Strong quarterly results from big companies like Reliance Industries and Bank of Baroda may help support the market. However, heavy fall in US technology shares and high crude oil prices could create pressure on Indian stocks. Simplified rules for foreign investors may bring steady investment, while high raw material costs remain a concern.

stories.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
stories.summary:
Reliance Industries reported a 41 percent year-on-year rise in September quarter net profit to 25,548 crore rupees.
Operational revenue rose 29 percent to 3,32,861 crore rupees.
Operating profit before taxes and depreciation grew 23.9 percent to 62,409 crore rupees.
The growth was driven by oil-to-chemicals refining recovery and telecom growth.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong quarterly profit from India's largest weighted stock could boost overall stock market sentiment.

stories.headline: Nasdaq futures tumble over 2% as Amazon, Intel stoke AI spending concerns
stories.summary:
US stock futures tumbled as Amazon increased artificial intelligence spending and Intel issued a cash burn warning.
Technology company shares slumped sharply across US markets.
Investors questioned high capital spending costs and overall returns on artificial intelligence projects.
The selloff spread across global chipmaker stocks.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Weakness in US technology shares may cause Indian information technology stocks to face selling pressure.

stories.headline: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9%
stories.summary:
Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 6,532 crore rupees for the September quarter.
Net interest income grew 9 percent to 13,026 crore rupees.
The bank's bad loan ratio dropped to 1.78 percent.
Global loans and deposits both showed double-digit growth.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher profits and lower bad loans in major banks could support banking sector shares.

stories.headline: Sebi eases FPI compliance, extends KYC review period from December 1
stories.summary:
SEBI extended the background check review period for foreign portfolio investors starting December 1.
The review interval was increased from one year to two years, and from three years to eight years for selected investor categories.
SEBI also removed a separate disclosure rule to reduce repetitive paperwork.
The goal is to lower compliance work for foreign funds.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Simpler compliance rules may encourage foreign investors to keep investing in Indian stocks.

stories.headline: GAIL Q2 Results: Profit zooms 139% YoY to Rs 4,720 crore, revenue rises 33%; board approves GAIL Gas IPO
stories.summary:
GAIL India reported a 139.3 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 4,720 crore rupees for the September quarter.
Revenue from operations increased by 32.7 percent.
The company board approved listing its subsidiary GAIL Gas Limited on stock exchanges through an initial public offering.
The board approved a 25 percent equity sale in the subsidiary.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: High earnings growth and subsidiary listing plans may support natural gas and energy shares.

stories.headline: India bonds buckle for fourth straight month on oil's climb
stories.summary:
Indian government bond prices fell for a fourth straight month as crude oil prices climbed.
Higher crude oil prices raised domestic inflation concerns.
The Reserve Bank of India raised its policy interest rate earlier in the month.
Foreign investment in Indian government bonds fell to a four-month low.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Higher crude oil prices and falling bond prices could increase costs for companies and weigh on market sentiment.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
stories.summary:
Jio Platforms reported a 14 percent year-on-year rise in net profit to 8,389 crore rupees for the September quarter.
Revenue grew 11 percent to 40,475 crore rupees.
The company added 9.1 million subscribers during the quarter.
Average revenue per user increased to 218.8 rupees.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Steady profit and subscriber growth in telecom operations may support telecom and parent company shares.

stories.headline: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
stories.summary:
Sun Pharma reported a 36 percent year-on-year drop in September quarter net profit to 1,989 crore rupees due to legal and acquisition costs.
Revenue increased 11.8 percent driven by domestic and emerging market sales.
US sales weakened during the quarter.
Exceptional legal expenses hit overall profitability.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Lower net profit in India's top pharmaceutical company may create pressure on healthcare sector shares.

stories.headline: Asian Paints’ consolidated profit jumps 7.5% YoY in Q2
stories.summary:
Asian Paints reported a 7.5 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 1,067.6 crore rupees for the September quarter.
Net sales grew 16.9 percent to 9,953.9 crore rupees.
Higher raw material costs hurt profit margins, prompting plans for price increases.
The company declared an interim dividend of 5.75 rupees per share.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Margin pressure from rising raw material costs may affect investor sentiment toward consumer stocks.

stories.headline: Rupee rises 33 paise to close at 94.93 against US dollar
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee rose by 33 paise to close at 94.93 against the US dollar.
During the trading session, the rupee hit an intraday high of 94.94 and a low of 95.28 against the dollar.
The previous close was at 95.26 against the dollar.
It opened at 95.21 before gaining strength.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: A stronger rupee reduces import bills for companies but could lower revenue gains for export industries.

stories.headline: Aditya Birla Capital Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 1,288-cr
stories.summary:
Aditya Birla Capital reported a 38 percent year-on-year increase in September quarter net profit to 1,288 crore rupees.
Operational revenue grew to 14,003 crore rupees.
Lending assets under management increased 32 percent to 2.34 lakh crore rupees.
Company shares gained 1.75 percent following the results.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Healthy loan growth and higher profits may support non-banking finance company shares.

stories.headline: Why IndiGo shares flew over 4% despite 3rd straight quarterly loss amid higher fuel costs: What lies ahead?
stories.summary:
InterGlobe Aviation reported a net loss of 1,880 crore rupees for the September quarter, which was smaller than expected.
Quarterly revenue grew 26 percent year-on-year.
Aircraft fuel costs jumped by 67 percent during the quarter.
Company shares rose over 4 percent after the results.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Narrower losses than expected gave short-term support, but sharp increases in fuel costs pose ongoing challenges for airlines.

stories.headline: Sebi imposes ₹1 crore fine on CDSL for multiple compliance lapses
stories.summary:
SEBI imposed a penalty of 1 crore rupees on Central Depository Services India Limited for regulatory compliance lapses.
The lapses included failing to give rejection reasons for pledge requests and deficiencies in disaster recovery tests.
CDSL was directed to pay the penalty within 45 days.
SEBI issued the order on Friday.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Regulatory penalties and operational lapses could hurt investor confidence in market infrastructure companies.

stories.headline: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
stories.summary:
SEBI issued a final regulatory censure against Axis Capital regarding past underwriting restrictions.
The regulator noted there was no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default.
Axis Bank stated it expects no material impact on its business operations.
Axis Bank shares fell over 1 percent after the announcement.
stories.impact: Little effect on Nifty: Official closure of regulatory proceedings without recorded investor harm limits financial damage to the bank.

stories.headline: India’s forex reserves fall by $1.269 billion to $719.748 billion
stories.summary:
India's foreign exchange reserves declined by 1.269 billion US dollars to 719.748 billion US dollars.
The fall follows a previous weekly decline in total reserves.
Foreign currency assets and gold holdings showed mixed movements during the week.
India's reserve position with the IMF also showed changes.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: A small decline in foreign currency reserves is normal and unlikely to significantly change broader market direction.
